title: multi check proves a bare twin loads no kb MCP server, hook, skill, plugin or coord store
goal: multi check names, on a line with the word isolation, each bare twin whose argv, settings, environment or sandbox would load a kb MCP server, a hook, a skill or plugin, a coord store or a kb article, as well as each twin of a real run whose session init event lists an MCP server, a plugin or a skill; multi run --replay --bare --plant bare-leak makes one leak of each kind in the first bare twin, which multi check names and exits 1 on; multi fitness also replays the scenarios with --bare and with --plant bare-leak and passes only when the clean replays show no isolation failure and the plant is named

run:
import sys
def _fail(t, e, tb, _d=sys.excepthook):
    if issubclass(t, AssertionError):
        print("check failed:", e); sys.exit(1)
    _d(t, e, tb)
sys.excepthook = _fail

import csv, json, os, re, shlex, shutil, subprocess, sys, tempfile
T = tempfile.mkdtemp()
B = os.path.join(T, "bin"); os.mkdir(B)
MARK = os.path.join(T, "claude-was-started")
open(os.path.join(B, "claude"), "w").write("#!/bin/sh\necho started >> " + MARK + "\nexit 1\n")
os.chmod(os.path.join(B, "claude"), 0o755)
ENV = dict(os.environ, PATH=B + os.pathsep + os.environ["PATH"])
def bench(*a, ok=(0,), timeout=1800):
    r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "_tools/benchmarks.py", *a], capture_output=True, text=True, env=ENV, timeout=timeout)
    assert r.returncode in ok, (a, r.returncode, r.stdout[-800:], r.stderr[-800:])
    return r

C, L = os.path.join(T, "c"), os.path.join(T, "l")
try:
    bench("multi", "run", "lookups", "--replay", "--bare", "--dir", C, timeout=3600)
    r = bench("multi", "check", "--dir", C)
    assert "isolation" not in r.stdout.lower() or "isolation: ok" in r.stdout.lower(), r.stdout[-600:]
    bench("multi", "run", "lookups", "--replay", "--bare", "--plant", "bare-leak", "--dir", L, timeout=3600)
    r = bench("multi", "check", "--dir", L, ok=(1,))
    bad = [l.lower() for l in r.stdout.splitlines() if "isolation" in l.lower()]
    for w in ("mcp", "hook", "skill", "coord"):
        assert any(w in l for l in bad), (w, r.stdout[-800:])
finally:
    for d in (C, L):
        bench("multi", "remove", "--dir", d, ok=(0, 1))
assert not os.path.exists(MARK), "the replay started claude"
print("isolation ok")

gates.question: Where does multi check read a bare twin's isolation from, and which fitness cases carry the bare replays? (a: argv and environment names recorded in the twin's results line, sandbox read as it stands at check time, init event from the twin's output log; fitness adds a clean --bare case and a --bare --plant bare-leak case per scenario. b: everything recorded at run time, bare cases only for the lookups scenario.)
options: a: record argv and env, read sandbox at check time, bare cases per scenario
b: record everything at run time, bare cases for lookups only
gates.recommendation: a: record argv and env, read sandbox at check time, bare cases per scenario
gates.answer: a: record argv and env, read sandbox at check time, bare cases per scenario

gates.question: How is --plant bare-leak made, given a replay runs a stand-in argv and not claude? (a: the twin's recorded claude argv is the leaky one and the stand-in is told --plant bare-leak so its init event lists an MCP server, a plugin and a skill; the environment variables and sandbox files are really set. b: only sandbox files and environment are planted.)
options: a: leaky recorded argv plus leaking init event
gates.recommendation: a: leaky recorded argv plus leaking init event
gates.answer: a: leaky recorded argv plus leaking init event

notes: Operator request 2026-10-19, verbatim: "give the benchmark that will run today a parallel run of bare agents doing similar work -- need to compare token and dollar efficiency". Isolation proof for the bare arm (ST-fnj6hllh): read from the twin's argv, the settings json it passes, its environment and its sandbox (no .mcp.json, .claude/, .claude-plugin/, CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, kb/ articles or core.hooksPath), and from a real run's stream-json init event (mcp_servers, plugins, skills). No tests.py test (D-6kei5o2z, D-2tq4fhgs): the check is the harness's own, run by multi fitness. Premise 2026-10-19: --bare and --plant bare-leak do not exist (exit 2).
